stage0260_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ミスリル$$ West Pacific BG HQ, Executive Office ～

stage0260_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...A singularity...
　If we can find it, we'll have a way
　to break out of the Prison of Time.」

stage0260_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$レディ$$
「More precisely, it would restore this world,
　which was born from the $$新世時空震動$$.」

stage0260_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$レディ$$
「$c will soon descend to the surface.
　They need resupply and maintenance, so they'll
　head to the Federation's Far East Branch first.」

stage0260_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Is there anything that might give us
　a lead in our search for a singularity?」

stage0260_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$レディ$$
「According to Dr. $$トライア$$,
　objects, places, and people tied to the world's
　divergence can all be singularities...」

stage0260_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Something that holds the fate of the world...
　Just like $c.」

stage0260_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$レディ$$
「True.
　Their predecessors, $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$,
　have saved the world from crisis...」

stage0260_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$レディ$$
「In other words, their very existence
　could be said to have shaped today's world.」

stage0260_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They are called bearers of the 《$$烙印$$》,
　unique beings buffeted by $$時空震動$$s,
　or so I have heard.」

stage0260_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They, and the singularity that triggers $$時空震動$$s...
　I believe there is some connection between them.」

stage0260_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$レディ$$
「So when $c acts, the singularity
　may react as well...」

stage0260_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes...
　It's only hopeful speculation, but in battle
　I believe they will surely encounter a singularity.」

stage0260_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$レディ$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ shares your view.
　So $c should keep giving priority to fighting
　the Geminis and other organizations, as before.」

stage0260_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's ironic, isn't it?
　Time is on the verge of stopping,
　yet events are accelerating faster and faster.」

stage0260_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Likely because everyone's egos are erupting
　before the unprecedented crisis of $$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0260_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ opposes the Earth Federation,
　yet is still trying to deal with the crisis...」

stage0260_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Meanwhile, people like Amalgam
　must know the truth,
　yet seem to pay it no mind at all...」

stage0260_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then there are beings like the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　and the Angels, who seem to transcend even that...」

stage0260_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$レディ$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$...
　Even if we break through it,
　it will mark a turning point for the world to come...」

stage0260_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$レディ$$
「To that end, $c
　must keep fighting.」

stage0260_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood.
　They'll move freely without focusing on singularities,
　while $$ミスリル$$ investigates their surroundings.」

stage0260_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「At the same time, we'll prepare for any contingency.」

stage0260_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$レディ$$
「I'm counting on you, Captain Testarossa.」

stage0260_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Was that a sigh?」

stage0260_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$テッサ$$
「One thing after another has happened lately.」

stage0260_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「How about it, Captain?
　Why not take a little time off?」

stage0260_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「As for that matter,
　with help from Doctors Lloyd, Cecile, and $$ラクシャータ$$,
　we now have a way forward.」

stage0260_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「An absence of around one week
　from $$メリダ島$$ should pose no problem.」

stage0260_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I think I'll take you up on that.」

stage0260_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Then I'll arrange transportation.
　Where would you like to go?」

stage0260_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「It's already mid-September.
　If you miss the summer, I would suggest Bali.」

stage0260_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This is my chance... I know where I want to go.」

stage0260_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Where would that be?」

stage0260_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I appreciate the offer, but I'm not in the mood.」

stage0260_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Rather, my greatest concern right now
　is that girl.」

stage0260_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Understood.
　My apologies for saying something so foolish.」

stage0260_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No, please don't let it bother you.」

stage0260_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Kaname...
　This is my apology for causing you pain.
　Just this once, I'll let you have Sagara to yourself.）

stage0260_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Though I'll still have $$カレン$$
　submit a proper report.）

stage0260_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well now, something happened on $$メリダ島$$,
　but with resupply and maintenance to consider,
　$c will apparently head for Japan.」

stage0260_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What awaits them there, an ogre or a demon...?
　Or perhaps a god...?」

stage0260_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just teasing you with a little foreshadowing.
　Now let's get fired up today... business, business!」

stage0260_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well now, something is stirring on $$メリダ島$$,
　but with resupply and maintenance to consider,
　$c will apparently head for Japan.」

stage0260_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What awaits them there, an ogre or a demon...?
　Or perhaps a god...?」

stage0260_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just teasing you with a little foreshadowing.
　Now let's get fired up today... business, business!」
